question: Who is the only Indian woman who has been ranked world’s no.1 for badminton?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Saina Nehwal**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Saina Nehwal** is the only Indian woman who has been ranked as the world's No. 1 in badminton.
 
• She achieved this milestone in **April 2015**, making history for Indian badminton.
 
• Saina Nehwal has consistently performed at an international level, winning several prestigious tournaments and medals.
 
• Her achievements have significantly contributed to the popularity and growth of badminton in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Saina Nehwal** was born on 17th March 1990 in Hisar, Haryana, India.
 
• She has been honored with several awards including the **Padma Bhushan**, **Padma Shri**, and the **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna**.
 
• Her success has inspired many young athletes in India to pursue badminton professionally.
 
• Besides her world No. 1 ranking, Saina has also won a bronze medal at the **2012 London Olympics**.
